name: orbit-workspace
description: Orbit — Docs, Boards, Chat. One workspace. (npm workspaces monorepo)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=orbitserver && npm run build --workspace=orbit
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.check-db: npm run build:shared && npm run check-db -w orbitserver
